title: 大型语言模型在医学推理中表现出元认知敏感性
summary: 本研究开发了一个基于心理物理学启发的临床基准，评估医学LLM的诊断准确性和置信度校准。在gpt-4.1-nano上，诊断准确率93.5%，置信度与证据强度相关，但存在局部校准失败。研究强调直接测量置信度质量，而非从准确率推断。
summary_en: This study develops a psychophysics-inspired clinical benchmark to evaluate diagnostic accuracy and confidence calibration in medical LLMs. On gpt-4.1-nano, accuracy was 93.5%, confidence tracked evidence strength, but localized calibration failures were found. The study emphasizes measuring confidence quality directly.
